summary: Frontend-only DOM/visual testing of /comprovante-inscricao.html for the 2 reported bugs: (1) RG field replaced by 'Inscrição' showing __protocolo, (2) PIX amount fallback via concurso.js catalog lookupPrice() when localStorage VALOR is absent. Planted localStorage same-origin then reloaded. All 5 scenarios PASS (5/5).
critical_code_review_comments: Both bugs correctly fixed. #f-rg no longer in DOM; #f-inscricao renders d.__protocolo. lookupPrice() correctly reads window.SEAD_CONCURSO.catalogo scoped by concurso_sel key with fallback to all keys. VALOR precedence works (valor set first, lookup only if falsy).
Minor: networkidle never settles on this page (likely keepalive POST /api/track/pix-downloaded) — future tests should use wait_until='domcontentloaded' + fixed timeout, not 'networkidle'.
seed_data_creation: None. localStorage planted in-browser only; no DB writes made by test (track POST is app side-effect).
context_for_next_testing_agent: comprovante-inscricao.html verified: RG->Inscricao(protocolo) and PIX price catalog lookup all working across editais 24/25 and VALOR override. QR img loads from /api/pix/qr.png (naturalWidth 360).
